title: Actor_B clip metrics (tools/anim_graph/measure_clips.gd, plan WP2 section 5.4)
description: Measured clip facts the graph-driven PlayerAnim needs (travel speeds and strides, plant phases, bone masks, aim-pitch calibration, chest height) plus a ground-truth check against the Blender foot dump. Skeleton space: forward +Z, left +X, up +Y; heading_deg / yaw_deg + = left. Contract between WP2 and WP3/WP4/WP5 (fixture: tests/anim/fixtures/mini_metrics.json). Validated by tests/anim/test_metrics.gd with a GDScript validator that supports: type (incl. arrays of types), required, properties, additionalProperties, patternProperties, items, enum, const, pattern, minimum, maximum, minItems, maxItems, $ref (#/definitions/...). As in JSON Schema, required/properties apply only to objects and items/minItems only to arrays, so a definition with type ["object", "null"] also admits null.

bone_sets.description: upper: bones keyed by any aim_trees clip that are in the upper_base subtree or are root children named *_offset, plus upper_base; never root, the lower_base subtree or holster_*. hands: finger/thumb/palm/metacarpal bones and *_hand_prop_attachment keyed by any grip clip (grips.* and aim_trees.*.hands). stabilized: upper_base + (upper and root children), the AimStabilizer set. pitch_add_union: bones keyed by any aim up/down additive (aim_trees and aim_move). lower: root, lower_base and the lower_base-subtree bones keyed by any lower-role clip.

chest_height.description: skeleton-space height (m) of spined in the aim-idle base clip at t = 0, mean over weapons; the rig sits at the player origin unscaled

median_mm.description: null (with skipped set) when the Blender foot dump was not found

Intervals.description: contact intervals [first, last contact sample] as normalized phases; end > 1 when a cyclic clip's run wraps the loop seam

native_asset_id.description: copied from the clip's metadata (streamed clips carry a stream_ prefix); provenance, never recomputed

loop.description: measured: core bones' first and last samples within 2 cm / 0.05 rad; playback looping is the graph role's loop flag (travel.cyclic)

plant.description: l / r: plant-onset phases (a one-shot clip's stance already planted at t = 0 has no onset); l_contact / r_contact: every contact interval, including that one

heel_z.description: forward (+Z) skeleton-space position of each heel at t = k / rate (the clip's sample times)

body_profile.description: non-cyclic leg clips (starts, stops, reversals, landings, hit reactions): body travel from the contact path (meta.method.body_profile) at t = k / rate (the clip's sample times): cumulative displacement from t = 0 (fwd +Z, side +X = left, m), speed per sample (m/s), and coverage = expected fraction of steps whose velocity comes from a contact candidate (the rest is ramped across gaps); null for cyclic, additive and leg-less clips. The time-resolved reference for one-shot clips (travel.kind one_shot_mean is only a mean)

blender.description: present when the clip is in the Blender foot dump: the travel estimator chain on the dump at its own rate with the clip's cyclic flag (null speed / estimator when it finds no planted run there; rel_diff only when travel.estimator matches), the worst heel/ball distance between Godot and the dump over the dump's samples and its time, and the contact path run on the dump's frames (profile_diff_m: largest displacement difference to body_profile; profile_peak_speed: its peak speed; null without a body_profile)

fidelity_warning.description: null, or why this clip's library values are not the authored ones (meta.method.fidelity: travel vs the Blender dump, a heel/ball sample over 20 mm off, body_profile over 5 cm off); WP4 / WP10 must not treat such values as authored

Travel.description: GA/vmm/bl/an.py method A with one documented fallback chain (meta.method.travel); speed / heading_deg are the contract whatever the estimator; null for additive clips, clips that key no leg bone, and clips without a planted run

stride_m.description: speed * clip length: distance covered per playthrough (normalized-timeline rate = speed / sum w_i stride_i)

cyclic_source.description: graph_loop: the loop flag of the actor_b_graph.json entries that play the clip; feet_seam: no entry plays it (or the built-in list), every heel/ball's first and last samples within 2 cm

seam_m.description: largest horizontal heel/ball mismatch between the clip's first and last samples (a looped clip with seam_m >= 0.02 pops there)

kind.description: cyclic: the clip loops; speed / stride_m are the playback-rate reference; one_shot_mean: mean over the stance runs of a start / stop / reversal / landing / hit, not a rate reference (use body_profile)

estimator.description: method_a: runs of >= 3 samples at the clip's rate (the plan's method); method_a_run2: runs of >= 2 at that rate; method_a_2x / _4x: runs of >= 3 at 2x / 4x the rate

method_rate.description: sample rate the estimator ran at: the clip's sample_rate, or 2x / 4x (method_a_2x / _4x)

contact.description: secondary, informational estimate (meta.method.travel_contact); speed/heading above are the contract

solve_up.description: largest aim-up weight the runtime solves over (meta.method.pitch_range: = max_monotonic_up)

solve_down.description: largest aim-down weight the runtime solves over (= max_monotonic_down)

solve_lateral_drift_deg.description: largest sideways barrel deviation from the w = 0 aim plane over the solve range, asin(sin(yaw_deg - zero_yaw_deg) * cos(elev_deg)) (what the AimStabilizer absorbs; raw yaw differences are ill-defined near vertical)

data_limits.description: each side whose elevation at the end of the solve range stays inside +-60 deg (the authored data saturates there)
